remediation_recommendations.action: Segregate Yield/Rate Spreads from Flow Events
remediation_recommendations.details: Move spread metrics (bps, yields) to MacroStressSnapshot or set nominal_amount=0.0 and store value in metric_value.
Store directional flows with nominal_amount >= 0. For deficit balances, invert the edge (source -> target).

remediation_recommendations.action: Model Refining Margins and Shadow Arbitrage Conduits
remediation_recommendations.details: Explicitly model maritime tanker losses, crude discounts, and Indian refinery retained margin so Inflow == Outflow + Margin.
Normalize all flows to annualized turnover rates (Hz or USD/year) before performing path cost optimization or volume comparisons.
